news.title: Tesla jumps 5% after Barclays upgrades it to Overweight on SpaceX-merger hopes
news.summary: Barclays' Dan Levy upgraded Tesla to Overweight and raised his target to $450 from $370, calling an anticipated SpaceX combination 'a key part of the Tesla bull case' and citing a return to delivery growth, FSD adoption and robotaxi miles. No merger agreement exists; both companies have only formed independent committees. TSLA closed up 5.21% at $391.62.

news.title: Musk's public endorsement of a SpaceX–Tesla deal may throw a wrench in talks
news.summary: Insiders worry Musk's comments could invite shareholder scrutiny over how Tesla holders' interests are represented, echoing the 2016 SolarCity deal, and delay the process by several weeks, a source said. Structures discussed include SpaceX acquiring Tesla or a merger under a new holding company, possibly all-stock. TSLA closed down 0.6% Friday at $372.22.

news.title: With earnings done, SpaceX–Tesla merger chatter takes center stage
news.summary: Musk said he had "said everything that should be said" on a merger; at Tesla a deal would need a 50% vote of all shares, and he owns about 19.8%. China, 22% of Tesla's revenue last year, and national-security reviews are seen as hurdles. Tesla fell 3% Thursday and is down 17% this year.

news.title: UBS raises its Tesla target to $425 from $391 on strong FSD uptake, keeps Neutral
news.summary: UBS lifted its 2027/2028 EPS estimates to $2.02/$3.17 after Q3, citing strong Full Self-Driving adoption; several other firms also raised targets after the report.

news.title: Tesla shares slip after its capex cut raises doubts over Musk's AI and robotics push
news.summary: Tesla lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about $20B from more than $25B after spending less than expected on AI and robotics in Q3, which produced surprise positive free cash flow. An eToro analyst said the cut explains why the shares went nowhere on a quarter that beat on most measures; Tesla trades at about 188 times forward earnings. TSLA closed down 3.1% as the Nasdaq fell 2.6%.

news.title: Tesla's lower spending target is one of three reasons chip stocks fell hard Thursday
news.summary: Investors were spooked by Tesla's rare capex cut, Lam Research's weaker-than-expected forecast and a reminder that the AI boom relies on outside funding; Intel and AMD fell about 8%, Micron 6.3% and Nvidia 4.4%.

news.title: Musk's public endorsement of a SpaceX–Tesla deal may delay talks, sources say
news.summary: Insiders worry Musk's comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, drawing comparisons to the SolarCity litigation. Structures under discussion include a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a merger under a new holding company. TSLA traded about 5% lower early Thursday premarket (Stocktwits).

news.title: Tesla's first Robotaxi Safety Report: 3.1M driverless miles, four cities coming next
news.summary: Tesla's new safety page says its Robotaxi fleet drove 3.1M miles with no safety monitor from Jan. 22 to Oct. 18, 2026, with zero reported injuries, airbag deployments or pedestrian/cyclist strikes (Tesla's own count). It lists Las Vegas, Jacksonville, Phoenix and San Antonio as coming soon, with no launch dates.

news.title: Tesla Q3: adjusted EPS 48¢ vs 43¢ expected, revenue $28.05B vs $27.9B; shares slip after hours
news.summary: Revenue was roughly flat from $28.24B a year earlier; automotive revenue fell 3% to $20.56B and energy fell 16% to $2.88B, while services and other rose 33% to $4.61B. Net income fell 29% to $787M (22¢ a share) and free cash flow was $1.53B. Active FSD subscriptions rose 67% to 1.74M. The stock closed the regular session up 3.41% at $386.47.

news.title: Tesla cuts its 2026 capex forecast to about $20B and posts surprise positive free cash flow
news.summary: Tesla lowered 2026 capex guidance to roughly $20B from more than $25B. Free cash flow of $1.53B beat an expected $4.92B burn, and auto gross margin ex-credits of 18.1% beat a 16.7% estimate. Shares rose 2% after hours, then reversed to trade down 2%. Musk said he had nothing to add on the SpaceX merger.

news.title: Tesla rises 2.2% after hours to $382.15 as Musk confirms SpaceX merger committees
news.summary: Musk said on SpaceX's earnings call that both companies have formed independent special committees to evaluate a merger; no terms are final and a deal would need approval from at least 50% of all outstanding Tesla shares. RBC sketched a hypothetical all-stock deal at $480 a share, and Cantor reiterated Overweight with a $485 target ahead of Wednesday's Q3 report.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review a merger
news.summary: The committees of independent directors were formed at shareholders' request, Musk said, calling the process 'an odd kabuki dance' since he is conflicted and can't take part. He cautioned that a combination is not a certainty and that Tesla shareholders would have to support it.
